title: Kyle Cooke Says Amanda Batula His Been “Getting the Brunt” of ‘Summer House’ Scandal Backlash as West Wilson Has Received a Follower Boost
summary: "I am worried about her. I don’t think West is in a place to offer her what she needs. I've been caring and providing for her for 10 years. It’s a weird position to find myself in," the reality star said. "He knew what he was doing. He hitched his wagon on Amanda's horse during her glow-up."
